hits.text: **Applicability:** The concrete tables, methods and recipes below describe the **implemented Core Schema 21 / Operational 1 / Search 1 baseline**. For target work, read the [ADR index](../../../docs/adr/README.md) and [transition plan](../../../docs/architecture/git-core-context-transition-plan.md). [ADR 0003](../../../docs/adr/0003-append-only-git-core-and-context-store.md) separates independently durable Context from INSERT-only Git Core; [ADR 0014](../../../docs/adr/0014-history-and-notes-catalog-without-file-archive.md) excludes ordinary file-body archival. [ADR 0026](../../../docs/adr/0026-stop-salvage-restore-merge-after-corruption.md) replaces quarantine/count/release and same-DB continuation with immediate catalog recovery. [ADR 0027](../../../docs/adr/0027-unauthenticated-external-capture-origin-reports.md) fixes unauthenticated external-origin reports without application PKI/signatures. Preserve unaffected safety principles; do not copy superseded baseline mechanisms into the target or infer new execution permission from this skill.

"text": "**Current implementation and newer target:** The implemented three-store/Schema 21 status is summarized in [implementation status](implementation-status.md). The later owner-accepted **target**, [ADR 0003](adr/0003-append-only-git-core-and-context-store.md), separates **strictly append-only Git Core** from **durable Context** (PR/Issue/comment/Provider facts), while retaining Operational and Search. Read its [transition plan](architecture/git-core-context-transition-plan.md). The remainder of this page is a preserved older design explanation; its physical placement and mutable-Core assumptions do not define the new target."

"text": "**Accepted newer target (not implemented):** [ADR 0003](adr/0003-append-only-git-core-and-context-store.md) freezes a strictly append-only Git Core, a separate **durable** Context store for PR/Issue/comment/Provider facts, plus Operational and Search. The [transition plan](architecture/git-core-context-transition-plan.md) inventories the necessary schema/runtime changes. The current `main` still contains the previous 3-store/84-table format; the design-only ADR does **not** certify a four-store implementation or any additional validation."

"text": "**Policy status:** Q01-B, Q02-B, Q03-B, **NO_INDEPENDENT_PUBLICATION**, and **PF-P01\u2013PF-P17** were accepted; the later [ADR 0003](../adr/0003-append-only-git-core-and-context-store.md) **now fixes a new target boundary** (append-only Git Core / durable Context / Operational / Search). ADR 0003 explicitly supersedes the incompatible physical-placement and full-backup assumptions of ADR 0002. This register reconciles the earlier Q/PF scope; it does not make an additional owner decision."

"text": "The [new accepted ADR 0003](../adr/0003-append-only-git-core-and-context-store.md) divides permanent Git facts (strict application-level append-only Git Core) from separately durable, updateable Provider/Source/PR/Issue/review text and metadata (Context). Operational and Search remain separate. **This is a new target architecture, not a claim that 70 Core tables have been moved.** Original Q01/Q02 latest-only and all other preserved contracts continue unless ADR 0003 explicitly narrows prior physical assumptions. GC-01/GC-02 conservative future manual-GC principles now concern Context text; Git Core has no admitted-fact GC. GC-03 mechanism depends on the final Context constraints; GC-04 remains undecided. See the [transition plan](../architecture/git-core-context-transition-plan.md)."

"text": "**Subsequent design decision:** This audit examined the implemented Three-Store format before the owner's 2026-10-14 acceptance of [ADR 0003](../adr/0003-append-only-git-core-and-context-store.md). Its original classification remains evidence of that checkpoint; the **current target** is Git Core (strictly append-only) + durable Context + Operational + Search, while the current production implementation remains Three-Store. ADR 0003 supersedes conflicting placement/full-backup assumptions, not the whole earlier decision set. Future manual Provider-text GC belongs to Context, not Git Core."
